## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: The credential detection regex is copy-pasted verbatim between the early-exit path (lines 219, 222) and _compute_security_overlay() (lines 643, 648). If the pattern needs to change (e.g., new provider prefix), both locations must be updated in sync. Extracting the credential scan into a shared helper function would eliminate this duplication and reduce the risk of the two paths drifting apart.
File: plugins/dso/scripts/review-complexity-classifier.sh
Category: design
